text:
Priya: Quick check — who is taking the 10:30 PT deploy slot today? Need a smoke owner and someone standing by for rollback. This is release E: kv-cache optimizer + small console fix, should be low-risk but want confirmation.

Marco: I can take 10:30. Deploying `feature/kv-cache-optim` (image rev a3f2). I'll own smoke. Plan: canary to 5% for 3m, then ramp if healthy. No DB migrations. @Jon can you be rollback standby?

Jon: Yep, I'll be rollback standby. I'll have the rollback artifacts and runbook ready. If Marco calls it, I'll initiate `rollback kv-cache-optim`. Staying on pager until 11:00.

Aisha: I can't do 10:30 but I can be secondary smoke owner for the 11:00 console slot. Marco, when you run smoke, can you paste the quick logs here? Also ping @ops-oncall if anything odd.

Marco: Smoke checklist I'll follow: 1) deploy to canary 5% 2) run quick smoke script 3) validate 200s + latency thresholds 4) check kv cache hit-rate in dashboard. I'll paste logs.

Priya: Please also confirm any rate-limit config or rollout gating if we see errors — we don't want a noisy ramp.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: deploy booked for Marco at 10:30 PT. Canary window: 3 minutes at 5%. Rollback standby: Jon. Reminder: update release notes after successful roll.

Sam: I can watch post-deploy for 20m and triage client-side alerts if they pop. Also will update the release notes with the short blurb: "kv-cache optimizer + console fix" after verification.

Marco: Running now. Smoke run output: ```
OK /api/health 200 0.12s
OK /api/search 200 0.09s
KV_CACHE_HIT_RATE: 68% (threshold 60%)
No error spikes in 3m canary window
```

Marco: All good :thumbsup: ramping to 100% over next 5m.

Priya: Great — thanks everyone. Quick protocol reminder: if rollback needed, call out exactly `rollback kv-cache-optim` in this thread and @Jon will run it. Leaving thread open for 30m for any late checks.

Jon: Copy that. On standby.

Aisha: Nice. I'll take the 11:00 console slot as noted.

Sam: Notes updated and post-deploy watch started.

Priya: Closing out — minor follow-up: Marco, paste the deploy link and final image sha when you have a sec.

Marco: Deploy link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/ops/1748976543 (image a3f2). Logged. :partyparrot:
